registered_before: stage 2 has not started and the v4 thresholds have not been computed; no attack of stage 2 has run. The capture pulse-token-capture-1107 is normal traffic only
owner_decision: 09/11: the system on the cluster is lidds-ml-v4 (sentinel_pulse/protocol/lidds-ml-v4.json). Its registered comparison kept lidds-ml-v3 by one false-alarm recording (36 against 35 of 7,938); the owner adopts v4 for its latency (p95 1.47 s against 2.09 s, 1,234 against 1,223 within 3 s)
system: replaces lidds-ml-v3 in section system.ml; the token model, the reference tree, the support model and the rule that one window above a threshold fires are unchanged; only the learning span, the threshold fit and the levels change

token_branch.model: learns every window of training + validation of the capture (12 h)
token_branch.threshold: the capture is cut from t0 into contiguous chunks of 1,800 s dealt to 5 folds in turn; each window is scored by the model of the other folds; per workload, moment Gumbel on the maxima of 60 s blocks of each container without the top 1 % (rule R4 of lidds-ml-v4), at alpha x 0.9
token_branch.why_chunks: LID-DS folds are recordings, which are independent; the cluster has no recordings and neighbouring windows are correlated, so a fold holds out whole 30-minute chunks. lidds-ml-v4 left this choice to the live protocol; 1,800 s is fixed here before any v4 threshold exists

count_branches.thresholds: moment Gumbel on validation block maxima as before, at alpha x 0.05 each

stage_2_run: pulse-live-v4-<MMDD>; arm names and the worker's field names (v3_tree_alert, v3_support_alert, v3_counts) stay as they are in the code; arm V3 of the protocol is this system
cluster_state: vCenter restarted all VMs on 09/11 10:19 after the capture. Recovery restored Vault, Redis sentinel pods, a Kafka volume and the ambient mesh enrolment of 43 pods; pods have new UIDs, and workload keys, images and traffic generators are unchanged. Vault gained an audit rotation sidecar (not a monitored workload).
